title: UpsertDisclosure
description: A non-financial disclosure — EU lobbying register entry, CDP environmental disclosure, etc. Each disclosure is keyed by (system, disclosure_id) and linked to its filer (a Company by gmr_id). Free-form `details` carry the system-specific payload so the schema doesn't have to enumerate every disclosure regime; downstream queries land on `disclosure_type` + `details.*` for filtering.

disclosure_id.description: Stable ID within the source system.

company_gmr_id.description: gmr_id of the filer when known. Optional because some disclosure regimes (EU lobbying register) file under entities that aren't Companies — those events carry the registrant's identity in the system-specific details map instead.

disclosure_type.description: Free-form sub-type within the system, e.g. 'climate-change' for CDP.
